Anna Katharine Green, Lost Man’s Lane.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anna-katharine-green/lost-mans-lane

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anna Katharine Green, the author and writer of the preface, died 1935 (citizenship: United States).

First publication of the text used: 1898 (SE colophon: 'Lost Man’s Lane was published in 1898 by Anna Katharine Green.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1898, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1993.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts; possible countries: United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1935, so the work is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2006.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
